description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages of three models, Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni, in two categories, MMAU and MMAR. The categories are represented on the horizontal axis, with the model names listed in a fixed order. The vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, marked at intervals of 10. Each model has two bars, colored blue for MMAU and purple for MMAR, as indicated by the legend. The MMAU bars have approximate values of 48, 60, and 64 for Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni, respectively, while the MMAR bars have approximate values of 30, 35, and 56 for the same models. The bars are grouped by model, with the MMAU and MMAR bars appearing side by side for each model. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
